principle: Validation depth and corpus scale are separate engineering problems. The validated analyzer contract is applied batchwise after gates stabilize.

tiers.purpose: forensic validation, gate debugging, E2E proof
first distributional estimates, outlier detection, genre-style coherence
stable descriptive distributions and rule stress testing
large-data batch analysis and subgroup comparison
optional expansion when source coverage supports it

stopping_rule: Do not wait for the entire target universe. Publish a cohort snapshot when the prespecified tier N and quality gates are reached; continue expansion as a new version.
scientific_note: N=5 proves the processing contract only. Distributional or genre-level inference must use the larger prespecified tiers and report coverage/selection limitations.
